description: Answers "Which of my backtests did better?" for 2 to 10 saved backtests: equity lines started at 100 on the same chart plus a metric table (total return, CAGR, max drawdown, Sharpe, trades). Runs of one strategy with different parameter values are named by those values. Results are simulated. Read-only. Shows an interactive panel in apps that support MCP Apps; always returns a text summary and a botspot.trade link.
name: show_backtest_comparison
title: Compare backtests
